verdict.rationale: Justworks is a payroll and PEO SaaS, and such a product could plausibly ship an in-app AI assistant that connects to MCP servers, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI assistant, an MCP client, or any way to plug in external tools. The only documented integrations are conventional Xero accounting syncs, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes both returned 404.
